newsitem.title: USA: Emons president/COO Alfred Smith resigns.
newsitem.headline: Emons president/COO Alfred Smith resigns.

text.p: Emons Transportation Group Inc said Thursday that Alfred Smith, president and chief operating officer, submitted his resignation effective September 5.
The company said Smith, who has worked at Emons for 16 years, is leaving to take a senior management position with a major railroad, but will remain a director.
Robert Grossman, chairman, chief executive, and former president, will reassume the presidency when Smith leaves. The company added that it does not plan to seek someone else as president.
Emons is a freight transportation and distribution services company serving the MidAtlantic and Northeast regions through its Pennsylvania, New England, and Logistics Business Units.
